parts.about_es: Preguntas sencillas sobre ti: tu nombre, dónde vives, tu día a día, tus gustos. Contesta con una o dos frases completas.

turns.examiner: Good morning. I'm Anna, and this is my colleague. What's your name, and where do you live?
Do you work, or are you a student? Tell us something about it.
What do you usually do at the weekend?
Tell us about the people you live with.
What did you do last summer?

useful_language: My name's…, and I live in…
Last summer I went to…, and I…
tips_es: Frases completas: no «Madrid», sino «I live in Madrid, in a flat near the centre».
Fíjate en el tiempo verbal de la pregunta: «usually» pide presente y «last summer», pasado.
Si no entiendes, pide que lo repitan: «Could you repeat that, please?».

parts.about_es: Describes tú solo una fotografía durante un minuto: quién sale, dónde están, qué hacen, cómo van vestidos y qué crees que sienten.

turns.examiner: Now I'd like you to talk on your own about something. I'm going to give you a photograph, and I'd like you to talk about it. Your photograph shows people having a meal. Please tell us what you can see in the photograph.

visuals.label: Photograph
visuals.description: A family of five is having lunch in a garden on a sunny day. A grandmother is serving salad, two children are laughing, and a man is cutting bread. There is a dog under the table, and behind them there is a small house with red flowers by the door.

useful_language: In this photo I can see…
On the left / On the right / In the middle…
I think they are… / Maybe it's…
tips_es: Usa el presente continuo para lo que hacen («is serving», «are laughing») y «there is / there are» para lo que hay.
Sitúa las cosas en la foto: «on the left», «behind them», «in the background».
Si no sabes una palabra, descríbela: «the thing you use to…».
Aquí la foto está descrita con palabras; en el examen es una foto real.

parts.about_es: En el examen hablas con tu compañero sobre una situación con varios dibujos: comentáis cada opción y elegís la mejor. Aquí, a solas, comenta las opciones en voz alta y decide.

turns.examiner: Now, in this part of the test you're going to talk about something together for about two minutes. I'm going to describe a situation to you. A friend of yours is moving to a new flat next month, and you want to give her a present for her new home. Here are some things you could give her. Talk together about the different presents you could give, and say which would be best.
turns.shown: Which present would be best for a friend who is moving to a new flat?

useful_language: I think… would be a good idea, because…
Yes, but… / I'm not sure about that.
tips_es: Di algo de varias opciones antes de decidir: a favor y en contra.
Usa comparativos: «more useful than», «cheaper than», «not as nice as».
En el examen pregunta a tu compañero («What do you think?») y responde a lo que dice.
Termina con una decisión clara: «I'd choose… because…».

parts.about_es: Preguntas de opinión relacionadas con el tema de la parte 3. Se esperan respuestas algo más largas, con un motivo.

turns.examiner: Do you like giving presents? Why, or why not?
What is the best present you have ever received?
Is it better to buy a present or to make one yourself? Why?
Would you prefer to live in a flat in the city or a house in the country?

tips_es: Opinión + porqué + ejemplo: con eso llenas los treinta segundos.
«I'd prefer to…» y «I'd rather…» sirven para hablar de lo que elegirías.
No pasa nada por pensar un momento: «Let me think…».
